# GOTO

> GOTO is a free open-source implementation of the GS1 Digital Link specification. It fully implements the specification, including the different compression methods and all the GS1 AIs known to date.

The development stack used for this project is:
- .NET10
- SQLite
- EntityFramework 10

The resolver scores 100% on the official GS1 test suite, making it one of the most complete open source reference for a Digital Link resolver.

## API

- [API reference](https://goto.it.com/api): A quick view of the main API endpoints for this resolver

## Demo

There is a live instance of this repository freely available hosted at the following URL: [https://id.goto.it.com/](https://id.goto.it.com/)
